text:
nina: heads up — onboarding sample shows full request ids at INFO even when LOG_LEVEL=info is expected to redact

leo: saw that in the new python sample? which sampleapp are you running?

nina: the new multi-lang bundle. repro: start node sample with `OTEL_AUTO=false LOG_LEVEL=info npm run start-sample` and python sample with `OTEL_PY_AUTO=true REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info python app.py` then hit /generate with header `x-request-id: clz_ab12cd34ef56`

harper: i reproduced. node sample redacts correctly (we strip `clz_[0-9a-f]+`) but python sample logs the whole id at INFO. looks like the python otel wrapper emits an SDK INFO log before our redaction hook runs.

nina: snippet from python logs (redacted inline):
```
INFO 2026-03-22T09:03:12Z incoming request headers: {'x-request-id': 'clz_ab12cd34ef56', 'authorization': 'Bearer ****'}
DEBUG 2026-03-22T09:03:12Z otel.instrumentation.flask: traced request span=... trace_id=7f5c...
INFO 2026-03-22T09:03:12Z handler: dispatching req_id=clz_ab12cd34ef56 route=/generate
```

leo: interesting — Node SDK initializes otel after express middleware by default, python instrumentation auto-wraps the app earlier. we have a parity gap.

harper: another wrinkle: python sample logs at INFO for prototyping, but in onboarding images we set REDWOOD_SHOW_DETAILED_LOGS=true so these leak into customer onboarding videos. bad.

devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-884: "telemetry: python sample leaks request ids at INFO when otel auto-instrumentation enabled" and draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/211

nina: proposed mitigations:
- change onboarding default to WARN for sample apps until we ship a fix
- add `redwood.telemetry.redact_regex` in SDK config (fallback)
- expose a `post_instrumentation_hooks` callback so apps can register redactors that run after otel init

leo: for short term i'll patch the python sample to run a scrubber as an atexit/stream filter that replaces `clz_[0-9a-f]{8,}` with `clz_<redacted>` on stdout. not ideal but quick.

harper: long term i like the `post_instrumentation_hooks` idea. also we should unify default order across SDKs: instrumentation should be opt-in for auto, require explicit `auto_instrument=true` so sampleapps don't accidentally change middleware order.

nina: added a unit test suggestion to DEVEX-884: spin up sample with OTEL env toggled and assert no visible `clz_` in INFO logs after an HTTP hit.

ci-bot: test run queued for PR 211 — builds will include python sample with scrubber patch.

leo: cc @platform: any objections to changing onboarding images to REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=WARN until we release sample parity?

harper: no objections. also adding a note to onboarding README: "If you enable OTEL auto-instrumentation, verify your app-level redaction runs after instrumentation or configure `redwood.telemetry.redact_regex`"

nina: thanks — i'll update the onboarding checklist and follow up on DEVEX-884 with implementation details for the SDK hooks. :thumbsup:

leo: leaving thread open for the PR review. we'll close when scrubber is in staging and onboarding images updated.
